Eyewitnesses recounted scenes of distress, with numerous individuals fainting under the circumstances. Emergency services acted quickly, transporting the seriously injured to Calcutta Medical College.

title: 'Thoughts with those who have lost their loved ones': PM Modi on Kolkata stampede
content: The incident occurred around 7.40 pm in the Girish Park police station area amid heavy crowds of pandal visitors and rainfall. As rain began, people waiting outside the pandal rushed forward, causing some to fall on the road and triggering a stampede, a senior police officer told PTI. All the injured were rescued and taken to Calcutta Medical College for treatment.

title: Kolkata pandal stampede: Heavy rush amid rain led to deadly incident - top developments

Emergency services transported the injured to Calcutta Medical College and Hospital for immediate medical assistance. The West Bengal health minister, alongside other political leaders, responded by visiting the scene and the hospital.

title: Texas tenants win damages and legal fees after landlord keeps $2,600 deposit
content: In a recent Texas court case, a landlord's attempt to retain a couple's security deposit, along with demands for extra payments post-move-out, was contested. The tenants triumphed, though the court adjusted some damage estimates. Texas statutes mandate landlords to avoid withholding deposits for usual wear and tear and to furnish detailed deductions. The ruling underlines the necessity for landlords to adhere to security deposit regulations strictly.

title: ‘People fainted, taken on bikes’: Eyewitness on Kolkata pandal stampede
content: A tragic stampede occurred at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata on Saturday evening. This incident was triggered by a sudden crowd surge as rain fell, causing panic among waiting devotees. Eyewitnesses reported numerous people losing consciousness and being carried away for medical assistance. Authorities, including police and disaster management teams, have been deployed to assist the injured.

title: Amit Shah cancels all programs in Kolkata, to meet victims in hospital
content: In a heartbreaking incident at a Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata, a stampede claimed the lives of at least 17 people and left 15 others injured amid a surge of visitors driven by panic from heavy rains. Rescue efforts were promptly initiated, and medical staff rushed the injured to hospitals.

title: Bob Dylan bought Scottish estate for £2.2m; 17 years later, it sold for £4.26m
content: In December 2023, Bob Dylan and his brother David Zimmerman listed their expansive Aultmore House estate for an impressive £4.257 million. This stunning 25-acre property, featuring 16 bedrooms, is nestled in the picturesque Cairngorms National Park. Since the onset of the Covid-19 pandemic, the siblings had not returned to the mansion, prompting their decision to sell.

title: Brad Paisley and wife help open free Nashville grocery store with $1m gift
content: Brad Paisley and Kimberly Williams-Paisley have expanded their philanthropic efforts by launching a second location of The Store, a nonprofit grocery aimed at combating food insecurity in Nashville. Following their first store's success in 2020, which garnered over 3,100 dedicated volunteers, the couple has invested $1 million into this new initiative to ensure families receive dignified access to food choices and additional resources.

title: USCIS: Anyone who ‘guarantees’ a faster visa or Green Card is scamming you
content: USCIS warns immigrants and visa applicants about fraudulent schemes that promise quicker visa approvals in exchange for monetary fees. These scams frequently involve false claims of having special ties to government officials. USCIS insists that no one can hasten the immigration process through personal connections. Individuals should file applications independently and trust assistance only from recognized professionals. Recognizing fraudulent emails and suspicious offers is essential to protect against these scams.

title: Reese Witherspoon buys back Hello Sunshine five years after $900m deal
content: Reese Witherspoon's recent collaboration with Mediawan to reacquire Hello Sunshine from Candle Media marks a pivotal moment in the entertainment sector. This transaction underscores rising transformations in valuation methods, as Hello Sunshine had previously commanded a valuation surpassing $900 million. With an ambition to enhance its narrative quality and global presence, Witherspoon is dedicated to guiding the company's creative trajectory and upcoming projects.

title: Why Trump's plan to unleash 'Mother Of All Bombs' may fall flat in Iran
content: Military discussions are considering the use of the MOAB against Iran's nuclear facilities and military targets. However, the effectiveness of the MOAB is limited against deeply buried sites protected by reinforced concrete. Analysts highlight that the GBU-57 penetrator is better suited for such underground facilities, which require specialized weapons for effective targeting. While the MOAB has a strong psychological impact, its military utility against hardened targets is questionable.

title: Rain washes out series decider after India script history vs West Indies
content: In a remarkable display, India achieved the quickest team fifty in men's T20I cricket, accomplishing this feat in a mere 2.5 overs against the West Indies. Unfortunately, relentless rain led to the abandonment of the match. The series concluded with both teams even at 2-2 after five thrilling encounters, with India's swift scoring and the record-setting fifty marking a high point in the series finale.

title: Tiger Woods’ children Sam and Charlie: How are they shaping his golf legacy?
content: Tiger Woods allows his children to pursue their own interests and dreams. But has also left the door open for them to play golf. Sam has been at Stanford University, while Charlie has taken up competitive golf and signed with Florida State University, and their divergent paths underscore the lasting legacy of the Woods family beyond Tiger’s legendary career.

title: Brittany Mahomes has two words for Kylie Kelce after her heartfelt praise

Brittany is a co-owner of the Kansas City Current, contributing to the growth of women's sports. Her athletic background includes playing college soccer and founding Brittany Lynne Fitness. The establishment of CPKC Stadium highlights the investment in women's soccer in the area. Brittany's work emphasizes her individual identity beyond being an NFL player's wife.

title: '9 murders' claim, then clarification: How 'Chhote Sarkar' put Nitish on the spot

They call him 'Chhote Sarkar', or little lord, because in the Barh and Mokama belt his word has often counted for more than the government’s. His story begins with his elder brother, Dilip Singh, who won as an independent and became a minister in Lalu Prasad’s cabinet during its first term, from 1990 to 1995.

title: Woman scribe, who accused Rahul of manhandling, files complaint

title: UP man strangles sister with dupatta after finding man in her room at 3.30am
content: Ashish Kumar allegedly strangled his sister Komal to death after discovering a young man in her room. This incident occurred on October 16 at their home in Lakhanor village. Following a complaint made by the victim's uncle, police arrested Kumar on the same day. During interrogation, Kumar admitted to killing Komal during an argument over the situation. He was later produced in court after completing all necessary legal procedures.

title: Bhuvneshwar Kumar makes India comeback after four years

Captain Shreyas Iyer has included Bhuvneshwar along with Shivam Dube in the playing XI. West Indies leader Shai Hope opted for a bowling-first strategy, hoping to leverage it to his team's advantage.

title: SC’s enquiry committee launches complaint portal over violence during July protests
content: A complaint portal has been launched by the High Powered Enquiry Committee for individuals affected by protests. This portal allows victims to confidentially submit their complaints regarding violence that occurred in July. The Ministry of Home Affairs stated that submissions can also be made in person or via post. The committee will prioritize cases involving serious violence, especially against women protesters.

title: Madras HC: Covid ‘destroyed’ marriage, pandemic disputes need separate treatment

title: 'Can't die like this': Indian pilot Smit Machchhar recalls flydubai flight ordeal

With injury and determination, Machchhar opened the cockpit door, allowing passengers to step in and restrain the assailant. The aircraft landed safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, following a critical altitude drop.

title: 'Can't believe he's not first choice': Clarke slams India over Kuldeep snub

Experts like Michael Clarke emphasize that Kuldeep's knack for claiming wickets is invaluable in T20 matches. Meanwhile, Naman Dhir has adequately taken on the role of the second spinner. Nevertheless, Kuldeep's past performances against the West Indies, along with his extensive experience, raise important questions about India's future selection policies.

title: Man killed, four injured in suspected militant attack on Kuki village in Manipur

Gunfire erupted between the militants and a local armed faction, with the violence persisting into the evening. Emergency services promptly transported the injured to a hospital, but sadly, one victim did not survive.

title: 'Arbitrary, unreasonable’: Actor Imran Khan moves HC to challenge 'leave India' notice
content: Imran Khan Pal filed a petition against a notice mandating his departure from India by October 28. He claims the notice violates his fundamental rights under the Indian Constitution and lacks justification. Khan argues that he has lived in India since he was two years old and is an Overseas Citizen of India. The notice was issued following his attendance at a protest, leading to claims of arbitrary detention.

Aslam sent an alarming email to his employer before the incident, indicating a distressing situation. Police suspect that Aslam may have killed his wife before taking his own life. Relatives claim that Aslam had been struggling with depression for about 18 months prior to the tragedy.

title: Imagine Sisyphus posting: The absurd economics of India’s creator boom
content: the creator economy is booming, but for millions of aspiring creators, turning online visibility into a sustainable livelihood remains an elusive promise . one must imagine the creator successful, but is success within reach of everyone who has been promised a shot at it? in a world where almost everyone has some form of digital access to social media, is the creation economy truly sustainable or even democratised?

title: ‘Taking away right to vote, protest’: Uddhav backs opposition's ‘regime change’ call
content: uddhav Thackeray questioned the deployment of a large number of police personnel in Delhi during protests called by the Cockroach Janta Party . he said those who claim to have brought Ram are scared of cockroaches .

title: 'Do something. You can’t die like this': Capt Smit Machchar recounts flydubai attack
content: 'there was a moment I told myself, Smit, do something, you can’t die like this,' said the flydubai commander . he recounted the sept 30 terror attack on flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv . the flight was diverted and landed in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia .

title: Pope Leo walks out of hospital 4 days after lung cancer surgery
content: leo XIV greeted patients inside the hospital before walking unaided to his waiting vehicle . he also briefly stopped when a teenage girl presented him with a homemade papal doll . the pope was expected to deliver the traditional angelus blessing on Sunday from a window overlooking St Peter’s Square .

title: Trump aide helped set up ‘sanctioned hit’ on Katie Zacharia: Report
content: former white house press secretary appeared on a primetime show on friday . she struggled to defend her record, including her claim to be a lawyer . one source described the appearance as a “sanctioned hit” on the former press secretary .

title: Watch: Bird strike damages Emirates aircraft in Delhi, flight delayed
content: flight from Delhi to Dubai delayed by more than 14 hours . aircraft reportedly suffered a bird strike while arriving in Delhi from Dubai . flight EK 517 is expected to leave at 7 am on Sunday, October 18, local time . airline apologises for the incident .

title: Blind UK man rejected from 1,000 jobs builds business, wins King’s Trust award
content: Brandon Hulcoop faced rejection after rejection while trying to find work . the 23-year-old turned his frustration into a business aimed at making everyday experiences more accessible for people with sight loss . he developed the confidence and practical skills to pursue an idea of his own, eventually leading to the creation of All Things Dotty .

title: US Congressman claims H-1B visa holders from India, China replacing Americans
content: alleged employers are hiring foreign workers because they are willing to accept lower wages . alleged that 650,000 americans graduated with computer science-related degrees last year . more than 500,000 H-1B visas were issued last year, he said .

title: Watch: Congress workers vandalise BJP Ajmer office over Madan Rathore's Pak remark
content: congress workers vandalised the BJP office in Rajasthan's Ajmer on Saturday . they smeared posters with black ink and wrote slogans on the walls . the protest followed a row over his remarks that he would support Pakistan if it played against the US .
